wants.name: Rooms above your level
wants.one_liner: Rooms where you are the student: operators two stages ahead of you.
wants.quote: I keep ending up as the one teaching. I want to be in rooms where I'm learning.

wants.name: Small rooms of equals
wants.one_liner: Six-person dinners of founders at the same stage, no agenda.
wants.quote: The best hour of my month was that dinner with five people who get it.

wants.one_liner: A clear view of what you build after this one, formed early.
wants.quote: I want to know what the next thing is before I need to.

wants.name: Frontier tech, up close
wants.one_liner: Time with people building robotics, space and AI systems.
wants.quote: I'd give up a board meeting for an afternoon in a robotics lab.

wants.name: A real pause
wants.one_liner: A deliberate break of at least three weeks, planned not stolen.
wants.quote: I haven't had three weeks off since we started.

wants.name: Superconnecting

wants.quote: The intros I've made are the thing I'm proudest of outside the company.

wants.quote: If we get Fernway and Larkspur, the year is made.

wants.quote: I want more people I can talk shop with who still write code.

moves.title: Introduce Isabel Fonseca (Tidewater Robotics) to Mira Castellano (Halden AI Lab)
moves.why: Isabel is hiring her first perception researcher and Mira runs the lab that trains them. They share no room except you.

evidence.what: Isabel asked for help finding a perception lead
evidence.quote: anyone you know who's done perception at scale?

evidence.what: Mira said two of her postdocs want to go industrial

moves.action: Email Mira first to check she is happy to be introduced, then send the double opt-in.
moves.draft:
[email to Mira Castellano]
Mira, quick one. Isabel Fonseca runs Tidewater Robotics and is hiring her first perception lead. You mentioned two of your postdocs want to go industrial. Worth an intro?
moves.headline: for-someone-else

moves.title: Introduce Oliver Hartley (Kilnworks) to Ben Achterberg (Fernway Hotels)
moves.why: Oliver wants a first hotel-group customer for his espresso machines; Ben is consolidating café-equipment suppliers this quarter.

evidence.what: Oliver asked for a hotel buyer intro
Ben is reviewing café-equipment suppliers before Q4

moves.action: Check with Ben before introducing: he is a live customer, so the intro must help him first.
moves.draft:
[email to Ben Achterberg]
Ben, you mentioned the supplier review. Oliver Hartley's team at Kilnworks does exactly the machine audit you described. Happy to connect you if useful, no pressure either way.
moves.hold_note: Ben is a live customer. Ask first.

moves.title: Reply to Kenji Watanabe (Northlight Fund), whose note has sat for five months
moves.why: Kenji asked for your view on a coffee-subscription deal in April and heard nothing. He sits on two boards you admire.

evidence.what: Kenji asked for a view on a deal
evidence.quote: would value 20 mins of your take

moves.action: Short, honest reply: apologise for the silence, offer a call this month.
moves.draft:
[email to Kenji Watanabe]
Kenji, I owe you a reply from April and I'm sorry it took this long. If the question is still live I'd be glad to give you 20 minutes this month.
moves.headline: repair

moves.title: Put three weeks off in the diary before Q1 planning
moves.why: You have said it twice this year and the diary shows no block longer than four days since 2024.

evidence.what: Stated want for a proper break

moves.action: Agree cover with Priya and block the dates.
moves.headline: for-owner

moves.title: Reconnect with Julia Brennan before her board seats turn over
moves.why: Fifteen months quiet. She chairs two boards in your sector and offered to mentor you in 2025.

evidence.quote: any time you want a sounding board

moves.action: Suggest breakfast; bring one specific question.

[whatsapp to Julia Brennan]
Julia, it's been too long. Would you have time for breakfast in October? I have one board question I'd really value your view on.

Amara, Sofia Marchetti at Kestrel is looking for exactly what you're building. Send me a paragraph and I'll introduce you this week.
